scripts.lint: pnpm -r lint && cd apps/api && ../../scripts/uv.sh run ruff check .
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r typecheck && cd apps/api && ../../scripts/uv.sh run pyright
scripts.test: pnpm -r test && cd apps/api && ../../scripts/uv.sh run pytest
scripts.format: prettier --write . && cd apps/api && ../../scripts/uv.sh run ruff format .
scripts.format:check: pnpm format:check:web && cd apps/api && ../../scripts/uv.sh run ruff format --check .
